lines.en: label rindorm55:
scene mommyshome1
I knock on Rin’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Rin 的门，等着她来开。

lines.en: scene mommyshome2
Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: : You’re not Rin.
lines.zh: : 你不是 Rin。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t...I be the one saying that to you? What are you doing in her room?
lines.zh: : 这话……难道不该由我来说吗？你在她房间里干什么？

lines.en: : Oh, you know. Just having a crisis. The usual.
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。正经历一场危机。老样子。

lines.en: : Where’s Wakana? Or Imani?
lines.zh: : Wakana 呢？还是 Imani？

lines.en: : Sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but I don’t usually take them to the dorms with me.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉给你带来坏消息，不过我一般不把她们带到宿舍来。

lines.en: : You come here often?
lines.zh: : 你常来这儿？

lines.en: : Are you hitting on me?
lines.zh: : 你在勾引我吗？

lines.en: : I wasn’t trying to.
lines.zh: : 我没那个意思。

lines.en: : I was joking.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, you’re not very funny.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你可真不怎么好笑。

lines.en: : And you’re not very clothed.
lines.zh: : 而且你穿得也真不怎么多。

lines.en: scene mommyshome3
: Yeah. Rin took my clothes to the laundry room so I’ve been stuck wearing this towel for the last twenty minutes.
lines.zh: : 是啊。Rin 把我的衣服拿去洗衣房了，所以我这二十分钟一直只能裹着这条毛巾。

lines.en: : I take it that means...you’re one of her moms?
lines.zh: : 那这么说……你是她妈妈之一？

lines.en: scene mommyshome2
: I’ve been told that I am not allowed to reveal that information to anyone.
lines.zh: : 有人跟我说过，这个信息不能透露给任何人。

lines.en: : Would you rather I just assume you’re some sort of prostitute she hired, then?
lines.zh: : 那你是希望我干脆当你俩是她雇来的某种妓女咯？

lines.en: : Hey. I may occasionally make out with random people I have only known for several minutes, but I’m certainly not a prostitute.
lines.zh: : 嘿。我偶尔是会跟只认识几分钟的陌生人亲热，但我绝对不是妓女。

lines.en: scene mommyshome4
: Though, there was one time in high school that I jerked off the singer of some band for a pair of front row tickets to a show.
lines.zh: : 不过高中的时候倒是有一次，我给某个乐队的主唱打了一发，换到两张演出前排的票。

lines.en: : Turned out later the show was free and it was all standing room, but hey. You live and you learn.
lines.zh: : 后来才发现那场演出是免费的，而且全场站票，不过嘛。吃一堑长一智。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if...that was supposed to be a joke or not.
lines.zh: : 我分不清……那到底算不算个玩笑。

lines.en: scene mommyshome5
: Honestly, man. My whole life is a joke right now, so go ahead and laugh at whatever you want. Just don’t tell Rin you saw me here. Or know that I’m her mom. Which I am. But I didn’t tell you that.
lines.zh: : 说实话，老兄。我现在整个人生就是个笑话，所以你想笑什么就笑吧。只是别告诉 Rin 你在这儿看见我了。也别让她知道我是她妈。虽然我确实是。但这话我可没跟你说过。

lines.en: : Anyway, want to come inside and hang out? I’m bored.
lines.zh: : 总之，要不要进来坐坐？我好无聊。

lines.en: : Is it really a smart idea to be inviting me in when you just said literally ten seconds ago that I’m not supposed to know you’re here?
lines.zh: : 你十秒钟前才刚说我不该知道你在这儿，现在就邀请我进去，真的明智吗？

lines.en: : Probably not. But since I have made nothing but poor choices over the last several months, I’m worried that breaking that pattern will lead to something even worse happening.
lines.zh: : 大概不明智。不过我这几个月来做的全是糟糕的选择，我怕一打破这个规律，会招来更糟的事。

lines.en: : Fine. But I don’t have any concert tickets to offer you in exchange for your services.
lines.zh: : 行吧。不过我可没有演唱会门票来换你的服务。

lines.en: : I downloaded that CashApp thing to send Rin money for a date last month. I can take that too if you also have the app.
lines.zh: : 上个月我下载了那个 CashApp，好给 Rin 打约会的钱。你要是也有那个 app，我也能收。

lines.en: : Okay, are you {i}actually{/i} a prostitute? Because I’m starting to think my joke was less of a joke than I intended.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你{i}到底{/i}是不是妓女？我开始觉得我那个玩笑好像没那么像玩笑了。

lines.en: : Man, I don’t know {i}what{/i} I am anymore. But hurry up and come inside before anyone sees me dressed like this and thinks I’m a prostitute.
lines.zh: : 老兄，我自己都不知道自己算{i}什么{/i}了。总之快点进来，别让人看见我这身打扮，以为我是妓女。

lines.en: scene black
I follow Rika into Rin’s room and...
lines.zh: 我跟着 Rika 走进 Rin 的房间，然后……

lines.en: Check to see if I have CashApp installed.
lines.zh: 查了一下我有没有装 CashApp。

lines.en: scene mommyshome6
: Look at us- like two peas on a bed. Hanging out on our own instead of in the company of a group.
lines.zh: : 看看我们——像床上的两颗豌豆。自己俩人待着，而不是混在一群人里。

lines.en: : We can finally play Yahtzee.
lines.zh: : 我们终于可以玩 Yahtzee 了。

lines.en: : Not sure how fun it'll be with only two people, though.
lines.zh: : 不过只有两个人的话，我不知道能有多好玩。

lines.en: : You know, I really should have guessed you were Rin’s mom the second I found out you had a daughter. I can see where she gets her...Rin-ness from now.
lines.zh: : 说真的，我一听说你有个女儿，就该猜到你是 Rin 的妈妈。我现在总算看出来她那股……Rin 劲儿是打哪儿来的了。

lines.en: scene mommyshome7
: No way. She’s way too level-headed and smart to be anything like me. My partner always said I’m just a few steps away from...
lines.zh: : 才不是。她比我冷静理智多了，聪明多了。我伴侣总说我离……就差那么几步了。

lines.en: : From...
: Don’t do it.
lines.zh: : 别说出来。

lines.en: scene mommyshome8
: GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！

lines.en: : Okay. Have fun crying, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那你就慢慢哭吧。

lines.en: : I’m not crying! I’ve moved away from the sad stage and am now in the angry one!
lines.zh: : 我才没在哭！我已经过了伤心的阶段，现在进入愤怒阶段了！

lines.en: : I’m a grown woman living in my teenage daughter’s dorm room! Why is this happening to me?!
lines.zh: : 我一个成年女人，住在我十几岁女儿的宿舍房间里！这种事怎么会落在我头上？！

lines.en: : Wait, you’re {i}living{/i} here now?
lines.zh: : 等等，你现在{i}住{/i}在这儿了？

lines.en: scene mommyshome9
: Pathetic, right?
lines.zh: : 很丢人对吧？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 有那么一点吧，嗯。

lines.en: : I won’t be here for long. Just trying to...get back on my feet, I guess. Start over.
lines.zh: : 我不会待太久的。只是想……重新站起来，我猜。重新开始。

lines.en: : Rin’s other mom is the one who technically owns our house, so when she told me to pack my shit and leave...
lines.zh: : 我们那房子在法律上算是 Rin 另一个妈妈的，所以她让我收拾东西滚蛋的时候……

lines.en: : Well, I packed my shit and left. No way am I getting arrested again. Jail is cold.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我就收拾东西滚蛋了。我可不想再被抓一次。监狱很冷的。

lines.en: : You were...arrested?
lines.zh: : 你被……抓过？

lines.en: scene mommyshome10
: You haven’t been?
lines.zh: : 你没被抓过？

lines.en: : Why would you just assume that someone else has been arrested? You barely even know me.
lines.zh: : 你凭什么假定别人也被抓过？你根本不怎么了解我。

lines.en: : Dude, look where you are right now. If the wrong person showed up, you’d be in the back of a cop car in no time at all. And that shirt’s so thin you wouldn’t even survive intake.
lines.zh: : 老兄，看看你现在站的地方。要是不该出现的人冒出来，你分分钟就得坐进警车后座。而且你那件衬衫薄得，连收押那关都撑不过。

lines.en: : That’s...fair. But what were you arrested for?
lines.zh: : 这……倒也是。不过你是为什么被抓的？

lines.en: scene mommyshome11
: Nothing fun. Went through a rebellious phase a while back. Lots of protests and breaking shit and maybe occasionally setting a building or two on fire.
lines.zh: : 没什么好玩的。之前经历过一段叛逆期。参加过不少抗议，砸了不少东西，偶尔还烧个一两栋楼。

lines.en: : We’ve all got our embarrassing background stories, though. Things don’t stay the same forever.
lines.zh: : 不过谁都有点丢人的过去。事情不会永远一成不变。

lines.en: : I mean, just look at me now. I’m-
lines.zh: : 我是说，看看现在的我。我——

lines.en: scene mommyshome12
: Wait...I’m even worse now.
lines.zh: : 等等……我现在更糟了。

lines.en: : My life {i}sucks.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我的人生{i}烂透了。{/i}

lines.en: : And it’s totally shitty because, like...everything was great just a couple years ago.
lines.zh: : 而且烂得特别彻底，因为……就在几年前，一切都还特别好。

lines.en: : Did something happen? Because the impression I got from Rin is that you and your “partner” were doing really well together.
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了吗？我从 Rin 那儿得到的印象是，你和你「伴侣」处得很好啊。

lines.en: scene mommyshome13
: We were. For a {i}long{/i} time. Like, I’m talking multiple decades...
lines.zh: : 我们以前是很好。很{i}长{/i}一段时间。我是说，几十年那种……

lines.en: : But one day, the spark just started fading.
lines.zh: : 但有一天，火花就这么开始熄灭了。

lines.en: : We tried making it work for Rin since we thought it would be good for her to grow up in a functional same-sex household, but somewhere around the time she started middle school...
lines.zh: : 我们为了 Rin 试着维持下去，觉得让她在一个健全的同性家庭里长大对她好，可大概在她上中学那阵子……

lines.en: : Things just...I don’t know. Felt beyond repair.
lines.zh: : 事情就……我不知道。感觉已经修不好了。

lines.en: scene mommyshome14
: I get it. I {i}hate{/i} it...but I get it.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我{i}讨厌{/i}这样……但我懂。

lines.en: : There was always this feeling in the back of my head that the next fight would be the last. But when that feeling was finally {i}right...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我脑子里一直有种感觉，觉得下一次吵架就会是最后一次。可当那种感觉终于{i}成真{/i}的时候……

lines.en: : Well, turns out I wasn’t as ready as I thought I was.
lines.zh: : 嗯，事实证明我没自己想的那么准备好。

lines.en: : It fucking blows, man. I really wanted things to work. Spent like half of my life with that woman.
lines.zh: : 真他妈难受，老兄。我是真的希望这段关系能成。我这辈子有一半时间是跟那个女人一起过的。

lines.en: : But you can fall out of love just as easily as you fall into it. So...here’s hoping that the two of us manage to fall again someday.
lines.zh: : 但陷进爱情有多容易，掉出来就有多容易。所以……就希望我们俩有朝一日还能再爱上一回吧。

lines.en: scene mommyshome15
: So anyway! Tell me about Rin’s girlfriend since I still haven’t gotten to meet her!
lines.zh: : 话说回来！跟我说说 Rin 的女朋友吧，我还没机会见她呢！

lines.en: : She lives right upstairs in Dorm 8. Just go knock if you want to meet her that badly.
lines.zh: : 她就住在楼上八号宿舍。你要是这么想见，去敲门不就行了。

lines.en: : I thought about it. But Rin told me she’ll introduce us soon and that rushing things would make stuff weirder than it already is or something. Which is apparently pretty weird.
lines.zh: : 我想过。但 Rin 跟我说她很快会介绍我们认识，操之过急只会让本来就够怪的事情变得更怪之类的。而事情显然已经够怪了。

lines.en: : They’re a...good couple, I guess. Otoha’s just a little uncomfortable about certain aspects of the relationship, I think.
lines.zh: : 她们算是……挺好的一对吧，我猜。只是 Otoha 好像对这段关系里的某些部分有点不太自在。

lines.en: : Like the aspect where they both have vaginas?
lines.zh: : 比如她们俩都有阴道这个部分？

lines.en: : Not how I would have worded it, but I think so.
lines.zh: : 我不会这么措辞，但我想是这个意思。

lines.en: scene mommyshome16
: It’s like that with a lot of girls at first.
lines.zh: : 很多女生一开始都是这样。

lines.en: : I lost count of how many I had feelings for only to find out later that they were “just experimenting.”
lines.zh: : 我都数不清有多少个我对她们有过好感，后来才发现人家只是在「试试看」。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll happen to Rin too, but...hey. Maybe she’ll luck out and get a good twenty-odd years with this Otoha girl in before {i}she{/i} gets kicked out and has to go live with {i}her{/i} daughter.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Rin 也会碰上这种事，不过……嘿。说不定她运气好，能跟这个 Otoha 好好过个二十年出头，然后被扫地出门，不得不去跟{i}她{/i}女儿住。

lines.en: : Man, I’m gonna be such a cool grandma.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我以后一定会是个超酷的外婆。

lines.en: : Maybe...wait a little while longer before you start fantasizing about grandchildren.
lines.zh: : 也许……你还是再等一阵子再开始幻想外孙吧。

lines.en: : MOM!
scene mommyshome17
: Hi! Welcome home.
lines.zh: : 嗨！欢迎回家。

lines.en: : What are you doing?! I told you not to answer the door for anyone!
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？！我跟你说了别给任何人开门！

lines.en: : Yeah, but what if it was {i}you?{/i} I didn’t want you getting locked out of your own room for all eternity because you forgot your key.
lines.zh: : 是，可万一开门的是{i}你{/i}呢？我可不想你因为忘带钥匙，被自己房间关在外面一辈子。

lines.en: : I {i}have{/i} my key!
lines.zh: : 我{i}带{/i}钥匙了！

lines.en: : How was I supposed to know that?! I thought I was being considerate!
lines.zh: : 我哪知道啊？！我还以为我这是在体贴你呢！

lines.en: : By letting my teacher into the room while wearing nothing but a towel?! Sensei is very weak to girls! Things like this aren’t good for his mental health!
lines.zh: : 体贴到让我的老师进来，而你就裹着一条毛巾？！Sensei 对女生的抵抗力很弱的！这种场面对他的心理健康不好！

lines.en: : Hey, you’re weak to them as well.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你对她们抵抗力也弱啊。

lines.en: scene mommyshome18
: Yes! I know! And just imagine how things would go if a friend’s mom led {i}me{/i} into a cramped room wearing nothing but a bath towel! It would not end well!
lines.zh: : 没错！{i}我{/i}知道！你想想，要是朋友的妈妈裹着浴巾把人领进一个狭小的房间，事情会变成什么样！绝对不会有好下场！

lines.en: : That’s a fair point. What I’m hearing is this is all Rika’s fault and that I did nothing wrong by going along with it.
lines.zh: : 这话说得有道理。我听下来的意思是，这一切都是 Rika 的错，而我顺着她走并没有做错什么。

lines.en: : Rin, I know you’re embarrassed- but hear me out. I already {i}know{/i} this guy.
lines.zh: : Rin，我知道你很尴尬——但你先听我说。这家伙我早就{i}认识{/i}了。

lines.en: scene mommyshome19
: What? How? You live like a gajillion miles away.
lines.zh: : 什么？怎么认识的？你住在好几亿英里以外啊。

lines.en: : Well...{i}lived.{/i} You live here now. But I’m like 99%% sure that’s against the rules, so I have no idea how I am going to make this work. Especially with you...opening doors for strangers.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}以前是。{/i}现在你住这儿了。但我有 99%% 的把握这是违反规定的，所以我完全不知道该怎么圆过去。尤其是你还……给陌生人开门。

lines.en: : But he’s not a stranger. I just said that.
lines.zh: : 可他不是陌生人啊。我刚说过了。

lines.en: : We’re actually drinking buddies.
lines.zh: : 我们其实是酒友。

lines.en: scene mommyshome17
: You don’t even drink!
lines.zh: : 你根本不喝酒！

lines.en: : I do now. {i}I am not the Mom you once knew.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我现在喝了。{i}我已经不是你从前认识的那个妈了。{/i}

lines.en: : What the fuck is going on right now?!
lines.zh: : 现在到底是怎么回事？！

lines.en: : You tell me! Imagine {i}my{/i} surprise when my drinking buddy showed up at my front door looking for my daughter.
lines.zh: : 你还问我呢！想想{i}我{/i}有多吃惊吧，我的酒友居然出现在我家门口，来找我的女儿。

lines.en: : I felt like a character in one of those Lifetime movies your other mom always watches.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己就像你另一个妈妈天天看的那些 Lifetime 电影里的角色。

lines.en: : Not to mention I’m barely even- wait! Where are my clothes?! You said you would wash them! I have an interview tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 更别提我连衣服都——等等！我的衣服呢？！你说了会帮我洗的！我明天还有个面试！

lines.en: scene mommyshome20
: I {i}am{/i} washing them. It takes {i}time.{/i} This is something you would know if you didn’t always make Mom do your laundry instead of doing it yourself.
lines.zh: : 我{i}是{/i}在洗啊。洗衣服要{i}时间{/i}的。这种事你本来就该懂，如果你不是总让妈帮你洗、自己从不动手的话。

lines.en: : Didn’t she just call {i}you{/i} “Mom” a second ago?
lines.zh: : 她刚才不是也叫{i}你{/i}「妈」了吗？

lines.en: : We’re both “Mom.”
lines.zh: : 我们俩都是「妈」。

lines.en: : Doesn’t that get confusing?
lines.zh: : 那不会搞混吗？

lines.en: : You’d think so, but not really.
lines.zh: : 你会这么想，但其实不会。

lines.en: : Get up. Both of you.
lines.zh: : 起来。你们两个都起来。

lines.en: : But what if my towel falls off? I haven’t even given Sensei my CashApp yet and it wouldn't be fair to everyone else if he got to see something like that for free.
lines.zh: : 可万一我的毛巾掉下来怎么办？我还没把我的 CashApp 给 Sensei 呢，要是让他免费看到那种东西，对别人也太不公平了。

lines.en: : I knew it. You {i}are{/i} a prostitute.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。你就{i}是{/i}妓女。

lines.en: scene mommyshome21
: NOBODY HERE IS A PROSTITUTE!
lines.zh: : 这儿谁都不是妓女！

lines.en: : Oh, thank God. It’s always so hard asking your daughter if she’s selling her body. Now I know for sure.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。问自己女儿是不是在卖身子，总是特别难开口。现在我可以确定了。

lines.en: scene black
: I SAID GET UP, DAMN IT!
lines.zh: : 我说了起来，该死的！

lines.en: scene mommyshome22
: Ugh...isn’t it supposed to be the mother who takes care of the daughter? How did all of this fall on {i}me{/i} all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 呃……不应该是妈妈照顾女儿吗？怎么突然全落到{i}我{/i}头上了？

lines.en: : Hey, I took care of you for years. It’s up to the child to take care of the parents once they can’t function on their own anymore.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我照顾了你好多年呢。等父母自己撑不住了，就该由孩子来照顾父母。

lines.en: : You are 43. You are plenty “functional.”
lines.zh: : 你才 43。你「撑得住」得很。

lines.en: scene mommyshome23
: I’m 42! There is a big difference!
lines.zh: : 我 42！这差别可大了！

lines.en: : Not really!
lines.zh: : 也没那么大！

lines.en: : I take it your house was always pretty loud, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 看来你们家一直都挺吵的吧？

lines.en: scene mommyshome24
: Shut up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！

lines.en: : Well, fuck me I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我他妈自认倒霉。

lines.en: scene mommyshome25
: Mom, I’m happy to have you here. I don’t even mind sharing a bed with you while you look for a new place. But {i}please{/i} be careful.
lines.zh: : 妈，我很高兴你能来这儿。你要找新住处的时候跟我挤一张床，我也不介意。但{i}拜托{/i}你小心点。

lines.en: : Not only do I want Otoha’s first impression of you to be, you know...{i}normal,{/i} but showing yourself around here could get me in trouble. And I can’t risk that right now. I {i}like{/i} school.
lines.zh: : 不光是我希望 Otoha 对你的第一印象是……你知道的，{i}正常{/i}，而且你在这儿露面也可能给我惹上麻烦。我现在不能冒这个险。我{i}喜欢{/i}学校。

lines.en: : How come Sensei can show himself around the dorms, but I can’t? He has a penis and penises are dangerous. I have seen things.
lines.zh: : 凭什么 Sensei 能在宿舍里随便晃，我就不行？他有阴茎，而阴茎很危险。我可是见识过的。

lines.en: : What does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 这都什么跟什么啊？

lines.en: : Can we not talk about Sensei’s gigantic penis and focus on the matter at hand, please?
lines.zh: : 我们能别讨论 Sensei 那根巨大的阴茎，专心说正事吗？

lines.en: scene mommyshome26
: Wait a second...how do you know it's a {i}gigantic{/i} penis?
lines.zh: : 等等……你怎么知道它很{i}大{/i}？

lines.en: : I...don’t. I just...you know.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。我就是……你懂的。

lines.en: scene mommyshome27
: Hey, don’t look at me. I haven’t done anything sexual with your-
lines.zh: : 嘿，别看我。我可没跟你——做过什么。

lines.en: scene mommyshome28
: Hm!
: Welp. Guess this is happening now.
lines.zh: : 唉。看来这事是要发生了。

lines.en: : Mom! What the fuck are you doing?! That is literally sexual assault!
lines.zh: : 妈！你他妈在干什么？！这可是实打实的性骚扰！

lines.en: : Leave it to a convicted felon to grab someone’s crotch without permission.
lines.zh: : 也就一个被判过重罪的人，才会不打招呼就抓别人的裆。

lines.en: scene mommyshome29
: You’re a convicted felon?!
lines.zh: : 你是重罪犯？！

lines.en: : I was planning on telling you on your twentieth birthday.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算等你二十岁生日那天再告诉你的。

lines.en: : What kind of present is that?!
lines.zh: : 那算哪门子礼物啊？！

lines.en: : Also, for the record, you were right. This thing is intimidating. Stay away, you hear me? They’re {i}dangerous.{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有，先说清楚，你说得对。这玩意儿确实吓人。离远点，听见没？很{i}危险{/i}的。

lines.en: scene mommyshome30
: Rika! You really {i}are{/i} here!
lines.zh: : Rika！你真的{i}在{/i}这儿！

lines.en: scene mommyshome31
: I thought Rin was just joking when she said you were coming to live with us, but-
lines.zh: : Rin 说你要来跟我们一起住的时候，我还以为她是在开玩笑呢，可是——

lines.en: : Hah...
scene mommyshome32
: Hey, Futaba! How’s it going?!
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba！最近怎么样啊？！

lines.en: : Nothing to see here. Just checking the size of your teacher’s penis. You know how it is.
lines.zh: : 没什么好看的。只是在检查你老师那根阴茎的尺寸。你懂的。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I really didn’t have anything to do with this.
lines.zh: : 这事真跟我没关系。

lines.en: scene mommyshome33
: I’m just...going to forget I saw that, since...that would...probably be best for everyone...
lines.zh: : 我……就当没看见好了，因为……那样……对大家都好……

lines.en: : You stay away from it too, you hear me? That thing could cause some major damage to a delicate flower like you.
lines.zh: : 你也离它远点，听见没？那玩意儿能把像你这样娇嫩的花朵伤得不轻。

lines.en: Joke’s on you, Rika. It already has.
lines.zh: 你开玩笑吧，Rika。它已经伤过了。

lines.en: : I will...be sure to keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 我……会记住这一点的。

lines.en: : What? Why are you looking at me like that?
lines.zh: : 什么？你们干嘛那样看着我？

lines.en: : I need somewhere to direct my anger. Futaba is a cinnamon roll and all of my rage just bounces off of my mom. You are the only target I have left.
lines.zh: : 我得找个地方发泄我的怒气。Futaba 是个小甜心，我所有的火气从我妈身上也全弹回来了。你是我仅剩的目标了。

lines.en: : It’s not fair that I am now the sponge for your anger when the only reason I am here right now is because I wanted to talk to {i}you.{/i} I did not ask to be groped.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿的唯一理由是想跟{i}你{/i}说话，结果现在成了你发泄怒气的海绵，这可不公平。我又没求着被人摸。

lines.en: But that doesn’t mean I didn’t like it.
lines.zh: 但这不代表我不喜欢。

lines.en: scene mommyshome34
: How are things going for you, Futaba? Good? Because my life’s a fucking mess right now.
lines.zh: : Futaba，你最近怎么样？还好吗？因为我的人生现在一团糟。

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll be back on your feet in no time at all. Our room is your room.
lines.zh: : 我相信你很快就会重新站起来的。我们的房间就是你的房间。

lines.en: : Yes. Hooraaaaay.
: Come on, Rin. Would it kill you to sound a little more excited? I might be homeless, but I’ve still got more money than you. I think.
lines.zh: : 拜托，Rin。你就不能表现得兴奋一点吗？会死吗？我可能是无家可归了，但我的钱还是比你多。大概吧。

lines.en: : I hope.
lines.zh: : 希望是。

lines.en: : And I’m full of awesome bisexual knowledge that I can bestow on you to make sure your relationship goes well.
lines.zh: : 而且我满肚子都是超棒的双性恋知识，可以传授给你，保证你的恋情顺顺利利。

lines.en: scene mommyshome35
: My relationship is going just fine! I don’t need your “awesome bisexual knowledge” when that’s, like...the {i}one{/i} thing I’m really good at!
lines.zh: : 我的恋情顺得很！我不需要你那套「超棒的双性恋知识」，因为那……大概是我{i}唯一{/i}真正擅长的事！

lines.en: : {i}Are{/i} you good at it? Because most of the time it seems like it’s your greatest weakness.
lines.zh: : 你擅长吗？因为大多数时候，那看起来更像{i}是{/i}你最大的弱点。

lines.en: : Aww, my little girl’s a disaster lesbian just like her mom.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我的小女儿跟她妈妈一样，是个灾难女同。

lines.en: scene mommyshome36
: Okay! That’s it!
lines.zh: : 好了！够了！

lines.en: : Sensei, a word please? {i}Outside?{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei，能借一步说话吗？{i}出去说？{/i}

lines.en: : Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。

lines.en: : But only because I feel like you might actually pop a blood vessel if you stay in here for any longer.
lines.zh: : 但只是因为我觉得你要是再在这儿待下去，可能真的会爆一根血管。

lines.en: scene black
Rin storms out of the room and I follow closely behind, leaving Rika and Futaba to...continue embracing one another while I step {i}away{/i} from girl on girl contact and into the hall.
lines.zh: Rin 冲出房间，我紧随其后，把 Rika 和 Futaba 留在屋里……继续互相拥抱，而我则从女生贴女生的接触中{i}脱身{/i}，走进了走廊。

lines.en: Not being quite sure of how much Rin even {i}knows{/i} about Rika’s situation, though...I’m not really sure how I’m going to approach this “talk” we’re about to have.
lines.zh: 不过，我不太确定 Rin 到底{i}知道{/i}多少 Rika 的情况……所以我也不太确定接下来这场「谈话」该怎么开口。

lines.en: The fact that Rika and...whatever the name of Rin’s other mom is were concealing the decaying nature of their relationship from her makes me feel like...well, like I shouldn’t reveal it either.
lines.zh: Rika 和……Rin 另一个妈妈不管叫什么名字，一直对 Rin 隐瞒着她们关系恶化的事实，这让我觉得……嗯，觉得我也不该说出来。

lines.en: But without being directly told {i}not{/i} to do that-
lines.zh: 可又没有谁直接跟我说{i}不许{/i}讲——

lines.en: I’m not really sure how things will end.
lines.zh: 我真不知道事情最后会变成什么样。
